headline: The David and Lucile Packard Foundation Announces the 2026 Class of Packard Fellows for Science and Engineering
summary: Packard announces twenty 2026 science and engineering fellows with five-year unrestricted support. The October article states $985,834 each, while a September announcement calls the current award $875,000; the amount remains unresolved and is not encoded numerically, and the separate $3.3 million emergency fund is not part of each fellowship.

headline: Packard Foundation Commits $5 million to South America Fire Fund
summary: Packard commits $5 million to the three-year South America Fire Fund, including data-sovereignty work in Brazil, Bolivia and Peru. This is separate from Moore’s $30 million anchor commitment and the fund’s $100 million fundraising target; no open application route or disbursement schedule is established.

headline: Packard Foundation Deepens Investment in Early-Career Scientists and Engineers
summary: Packard announces that the 2027 fellowship class will receive $1.017 million per fellow over five years, with increases reaching $1.065 million for the 2030 class. The article’s $875,000 description of current awards conflicts with the later 2026 cohort article’s $985,834 and is preserved as unresolved; neither figure is silently substituted for the 2027 commitment.

headline: Packard Foundation Directs Emergency Funding to Local Partners Responding to Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: Packard reports $700,000 for partner-led Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, naming five supporting organizations. This is the combined response funding, not an award to each partner; the explicitly stated $50,000 Environmental Defenders component and historical 2014 $2 million support are separate.

headline: Astronova Fellowship: Now Accepting Applications through October 2, 2026 - Heising-Simons Foundation
summary: The July Astronova announcement set October 2, 2026 at 2pm PT as the application deadline, which has passed. It describes four-year postdoctoral instrumentation support through host institutions, with conditional extension, innovation and startup opportunities; no amount is stated and no new cycle is inferred.

headline: 51 Pegasi b Fellowship: Now Accepting Applications through October 1, 2026 - Heising-Simons Foundation
summary: The 51 Pegasi b application deadline was October 1, 2026 at 2pm PT and has passed. The announcement describes up to $492,000 over three years for planetary-astronomy research, with conditional fourth-year or transition support; the ceiling is not encoded as a guaranteed award.

headline: Apply Now: California Child Care Justice Network Opens New Grant Cycle - Heising-Simons Foundation
summary: The California Child Care Justice Network application deadline was June 18, 2026 at 11am PT and has passed. The call concerns a five-year initiative launched in 2025; visible publication date May 7 conflicts with metadata May 8, so publication date remains unresolved and no grant amount or new window is inferred.

headline: Funding Opportunity: New Open Call for Science Events and Gatherings - Heising-Simons Foundation
summary: The science-events call closed July 10, 2026, with the announcement literally labeling its 2pm deadline PST. It advertised up to $800,000 total and individual grants of $20,000–$80,000 for specified physical-science gatherings; these limits do not establish a current open round or a guaranteed award.
